statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 that meets HIPAA and the insurance data security laws
Group CISO accountable; each regulated entity designates its own officials
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment per division with roll-up and enterprise risk report
Risk acceptance authority by level
Supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Common control catalog; inheritance documented within 90 days of an acquisition
Sanctions for violations
Intercompany services treated as third-party services: security schedule, due diligence, BAA review
Vendor security review; annual review of tier 1 vendors with complementary controls mapped
Annual independent assessment of common controls and division samples
Quarterly board reporting; annual written report to each insurer board including Third-Party Service Provider arrangements
Retention of security documentation and event records
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identities; no shared accounts
Least privilege; cross-division access approved by the owning data owner; minimum necessary
MFA for all; phishing-resistant for administrators and payment roles; step-up for payment release
Identity recovery verified to the strength of the authenticator replaced; help desk limits
Division-scoped administration; no more than 12 standing group-wide identity administrators
All privileged access through PAM including ERP superusers; emergency access reviewed in 2 business days
Separation of duties for vendor master, invoices, payment proposal, and release
Service accounts owned, governed, and certified
Termination within 4 hours; automatic expiry for contractors and surge adjusters
Quarterly access certification
Directory trusts and interconnections require agreement and approval
External identities: MFA for agents and employer clients; verified bank-detail changes
Plan PHI only for the plan administration unit
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Clocks start from the group SOC's knowledge for every affected entity
Notification matrix with commissioner, producer, and plan rows; counsel approves notices
Affected individuals counted by entity and state within 5 days
Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days of a materiality determination
Annual cross-division exercise with the matrix and a materiality decision
Restricted labels on all sites with Restricted data; no all-employee Restricted sites
Entity boundaries; routine-disclosure protocols; minimum necessary
Plan PHI stays in the plan workspace; no HCM exports elsewhere
Encryption in transit and at rest
AI assistants do not retrieve Restricted content except approved uses
Retention schedules enforced; secure disposal
Annual awareness training; role training for help desk, call center, treasury, payables, payroll
Verify payment and bank-detail requests through contact data on file
Approved AI tools only; no Restricted data except approved uses; no AI-based decisions about people
Recording only with consent where state law requires
